adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/larkcalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, both `createEvent` and `createAttendees` now derive `calendarId` from `const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = event.destinationCalendar ?? []`, i.e. always the first entry in the (now-array) `destinationCalendar`. Meanwhile the diff changes event creation to be per-destination/per-credential (`EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents` loops over `event.destinationCalendar` and `CalendarManager.createEvent` calls `calendar.createEvent(calEvent, credential.id)`), which requires selecting the calendar matching the current credential (as GoogleCalendarService now does via `.find(cal => cal.credentialId === credentialId)`). Lark ignores the calling credential and will attempt to write to the first host's calendar even when processing a different host’s credential, leading to events going to the wrong/inaccessible calendar.
